# Scriptoscope

> A browser runtime for original Kaleidoscope `.sit` and `.rsrc` schemes. Canvas paints window chrome and controls; content stays live HTML. Use the hosted page example without a build step, or install `@khawkins98/scriptoscope` and explicitly attach/clean up native DOM in your application. Theme archives are separate inputs with their own provenance and terms.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/README.md): setup choice, one complete hosted starter, adoption limits and documentation routes.
- [npm integration guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/npm-consumer.md): run the included Vite/TypeScript app, host a first-party theme under a nested base URL, and manage attachment, restoration and disposal. npm does not decorate the page automatically.
- [Hosted page recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/hosted-recipes.md): switch themes, accept a local archive, vendor a matching build, or explore the local demos.
- [Live installation guide](https://khawkins98.github.io/scriptoscope/install.html): copyable starters for the deployed hosted example.
- [Interactive demo](https://khawkins98.github.io/scriptoscope/showcase.html): try schemes, native controls and local theme files.

## Reference and troubleshooting

- [Hosted page reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/hosted-reference.md): `data-scriptoscope-*` vocabulary, `mountExplicitPage` options, handle methods/events and CDN paths. The host is an example helper, not an npm export; it captures sources once and exposes explicit attach/detach calls.
- [Runtime API guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/runtime-api.md): renderer-only imports, owned themes, native-control migration, measured display preparation and advanced composition. Public entrypoints are defined by package.json exports and src/index.ts / src/renderer.ts / src/declarative/index.ts.
- [Interaction reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/interaction.md): pointer, keyboard and touch behavior, plus DOM events, targets and details.
- [Integration edge cases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/integration-edge-cases.md): layout and sizing, framework lifecycle, CSS constraints, internal DOM stamps and troubleshooting.
- [Themes manifest](https://khawkins98.github.io/scriptoscope/themes-manifest.json): deployed theme slugs and attribution. Treat it as the catalog rather than repeating a fixed list.
- [Owned theme lifecycle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/v2/owned-theme-api.md): owned/borrowed assets and disposal boundaries.

## Explanation and project work

- [Project background](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/project-background.md): original authors, preservation context, design goals, project origins, rendering-evidence limits and a dated roadmap snapshot.
- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): contributor roles, implementation status and change-appropriate validation. Runtime implementers must begin with the implementer brief and its allowed reading scope; these general links do not expand it.
- [Implementer brief](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/spec/engine/IMPLEMENTER-BRIEF.md): mandatory role restrictions and assigned listing-free family specs for runtime implementation.
- [Documentation maintenance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/doc-sweep.md): editorial policy and canonical homes. Update the authoritative reference; keep README as orientation rather than an API inventory.
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/CHANGELOG.md): versioned release changes and migration notes.
- [Scheme creation guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/authoring-a-scheme.md): author ordinary Kaleidoscope resource forks and validate them in browser and native environments.
- [Port an existing scheme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/porting-a-kaleidoscope-scheme.md): import a community archive with its metadata and provenance.
- [License](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/LICENSE) and [third-party notices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES): runtime and bundled software terms; third-party schemes and demo fonts retain their own terms.
